issues.detail: The Greek 'κατα του μειζονος' (by/in the name of the greater one) is rendered as 'mượn danh' (borrowing the name), which implies a deceptive act not present in the Greek text. The Greek simply indicates the authority or means by which they swear.

The Greek 'πασης αυτοις αντιλογιας περας' refers to the 'end of all [their] arguments/counter-arguments'. The Vietnamese 'sự chống trả của họ có cùng tận' (their resistance has an end) changes the meaning from a finality in argument to a limit on resistance.
